evidence.title: GitHub Copilot Pricing 2026: Free to $39/user/month — All 5 Plans
evidence.excerpt: GitHub Copilot pricing: Free (50 requests/mo), Pro $10, Pro+ $39, Business $19/user, Enterprise $39/user. Compare all plans. Verified April 2026.

evidence.title: GitHub Copilot Review 2026: Pricing, Features & Is It Worth $19/Month?
evidence.excerpt: GitHub Copilot is the most battle-tested, IDE-agnostic AI coding assistant available in 2026. After extensive daily use across Python, TypeScript, Java, and Rust projects — and following every major product update through Q1 2026.

evidence.title: GitHub Copilot 2026: Complete Guide to Pricing, Agent Mode & Coding
evidence.excerpt: GitHub Spark brings natural language app building: Pro+ and Enterprise users can describe an application in plain English and get generated code with a live preview. Copilot was the tool that started it all.

evidence.title: GitHub Copilot Pricing 2026: Free vs Pro ($10) vs Pro+ ($39)
evidence.excerpt: GitHub Copilot now has five tiers. Pricing revolves around 'premium requests', a currency that powers Chat, Agent mode, code review, and model selection. Free tier's 50 premium requests per month is enough to test but not to rely on.

evidence.title: Plans for GitHub Copilot
evidence.excerpt: GitHub Copilot Free is available to individual developers. This free plan includes limited access to a selection of Copilot features and models, allowing you to try AI-powered coding assistance at no cost.

evidence.title: Cursor AI Editor 2.5 Review 2026: Models, Pricing, Verdict
evidence.excerpt: Cursor AI Editor 2.5 tested with GPT-5.2, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Gemini 3 Pro. Pricing, agent mode, multi-file edits, and who should actually switch IDEs.

evidence.title: Cursor AI Pricing 2026: Free vs Pro vs Business — Complete Guide
evidence.excerpt: Cursor is more expensive than Copilot and Windsurf, but its agent mode, Composer, and multi-model flexibility justify the premium for developers who use those features daily.

evidence.title: Cursor Review 2026: Pricing, Agent Mode & Verdict
evidence.excerpt: On paid plans, Cursor supports Claude Sonnet 4.5, GPT-4.1, GPT-5, Gemini Pro, Kimi K2, and Cursor's own Composer 2 model. You can switch models per conversation or set a default.

evidence.title: Cursor 3.5 IDE Guide: Cloud Agents, Composer 2.5, Pricing (2026)
evidence.excerpt: The guide covers Cursor's core agent, Composer, model picker, team workflows, pricing, and a comparison vs Claude Code and GitHub Copilot agent mode. The May 2026 updates are summarised.

evidence.title: Windsurf IDE Review 2026: Cascade, Devin, and the New Pricing
evidence.excerpt: Windsurf is an AI-native IDE (VS Code fork, formerly Codeium) built around Cascade — an agentic assistant with flow awareness — now integrated with Cognition's Devin cloud agent and powered by their proprietary SWE-1.6 model. Verified June 2026.

evidence.title: Windsurf Pricing (2026): Plans, Costs & Is It Worth It?
evidence.excerpt: Windsurf has quickly carved out a reputation as the price-to-performance leader in AI coding tools. It's a VS Code fork with deep AI features baked in, including Cascade, one of the most capable agentic coding workflows on the market. Undercuts Cursor and Copilot on price.

evidence.title: Windsurf Review (2026): SWE-1.5, Codemaps, Cascade, Pricing
evidence.excerpt: Windsurf is now owned by Cognition (the Devin team), bringing SWE-1.5 and engineering depth. SWE-1.5 proprietary model runs 13× faster than Sonnet 4.5. Fast Context retrieves code 10× faster via SWE-grep. Codemaps provide AI-annotated visual code navigation — a unique feature no competitor matches.

evidence.title: Windsurf Review 2026 — Cascade AI, Pricing & Alternatives
evidence.excerpt: Windsurf is now owned by Cognition AI following a ~$250 million acquisition in December 2025. Cascade — an agentic AI that can understand your codebase, suggest multi-file edits, run terminal commands, and work alongside you as a coding partner.

evidence.title: Claude Code by Anthropic | AI Coding Agent, Terminal, IDE
evidence.excerpt: Anthropic's agentic coding tool for developers. Claude Code understands your codebase, edits files, runs commands, and helps you ship faster.

evidence.title: Anthropic Claude Code Source Code Leak: Full Analysis (2026)
evidence.excerpt: On March 31, 2026, Anthropic accidentally published the complete source code of Claude Code CLI tool to public npm, exposing ~512,000 lines of TypeScript across 1,906 files. The leak revealed 44 hidden feature flags, references to an unreleased AI model 'Mythos', and internal architecture details.

evidence.title: Making frontier cybersecurity capabilities available to defenders
evidence.excerpt: Claude Code Security, a new capability built into Claude Code on the web, is now available in a limited research preview. It scans codebases for security vulnerabilities and suggests targeted software patches for human review.

evidence.title: Claude Code | Anthropic's agentic coding system
evidence.excerpt: Claude Code is an agentic coding system that reads your codebase, makes changes across files, runs tests, and delivers committed code. For builders without an engineering background, it's an entry point to software development.
